# Take section bounds from the loader, not from 0xFF runs

An 0xFF run in the file can lie outside the section load, so code placed there is never loaded.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md), [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md), [pen-f firmware 3.1, build 3101](../firmware/pen-f-3101.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md), [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md), [Olympus PEN-F](../cameras/pen-f.md)

Use the descriptor table and end selector, then check references, initialiser counts and runtime ownership. Emulators that map the whole file can hide the error.

> **What happens:** Calls into unloaded bytes run leftover RAM.

**Symptoms:** [Fails to start, restarts or loops at power-on](index.md#start-failure)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): Large FF runs in OM-3 1100 are mostly outside the loads. Source: [Finding space for added code](../sources/fishcu.code-space.md).
- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md)): An OM-5 II overlay ran 3,036 bytes past section 5; a direct-memory emulator fixture hid it. Source: [OM-5 Mark II startup readiness correction](../sources/om5.startup-fix.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): Caduceus gap probes on the OM-3 found leftover RAM, not 0xFF, between sections. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/fishcu/oly_fw_analysis/blob/d565cb664d3bc37f883f844a3a0c9620efe018e4/docs/safety/CODE_SPACE.md#om-3-v22-precedent)**
